note: Roster size cited, the rest designed (M4 milestone A). Per position: target (what a full roster aims for; targets sum to rosterSize) and max (the most a team may hold). Position minimums are not stored here: they are the engine's slot needs (slotNeeds over data/engine/personnel.json and the return units in data/engine/participants.json), so the two cannot drift. units: the positions each unit average is taken over. A 33-player roster (starters only) is a change to this file, not to code.
rosterSizeSource: NFL.com, 2026-27 National Football League important dates, https://www.nfl.com/news/2026-27-national-football-league-important-dates : clubs must reduce rosters to a maximum of 53 players on the Active/Inactive List. Read 2026-11-23 (docs/specs/m4-franchise-core.md, source 5).
